_note: The s.123 deduction: "the whole of the amount paid or deposited in the tax year, being the aggregate of the sums enumerated in Schedule XV, as does not exceed ₹ 150000" (s.123, p.159). Contributors are the Schedule XV clauses, in the Schedule's order (para 1, pp.561–563); clause (a) arrives with W-075a2 (D-134), each policy's premium already limited by para 2 (DED-PREMIUM-SHARE); clauses (c), (j), (k), (l) are held for W-075a3 (OQ-16, OQ-17). EMPLOYEE_NPS is sub-capped first at para 1(y)(i)'s "10% of salary, including dearness allowance, if the terms of employment so provide, but excluding all other allowances and perquisites" (p.563) — base SALARY, the employee-pension salary; limb (ii)'s 20% of gross total income for a non-employee is not modelled. What the sub-cap excludes feeds DED-NPS-OWN (s.124(3), (5), (10)). The new regime computes total income without "Chapter VIII other than the provisions of sections 124(1) and 124(2), or 125(2) or 146" (s.202(2)(a)(xii), p.227), so the old regime only. TY 2026-27 only; the 1961 version is W-075d (D-129 C2a). rulebook DED-80C-001, -ITEMS-001, -NPS-CAP-001. The 1961 counterpart, s.80C, 80CCC, 80CCD(1), 80CCE, is unread (W-075d).
